tools.name: scan-next
tools.purpose: Locate the next unprocessed game record.

tools.name: extract-domains
tools.purpose: Turn one game record into domain, subdomain, kit, and proof candidates.

tools.name: generate-packets
tools.purpose: Generate tracked kit-idea packets for the record.

tools.name: consume-record
tools.purpose: Mark the record tracked and advance the queue.

tools.name: prepare-rawg-batch
tools.purpose: Call NexusRealtime-Automations GameRecordBatch-Harness to select the next stable 50 RAWG records.

tools.name: advance-rawg-batch
tools.purpose: Call NexusRealtime-Automations GameRecordBatch-Harness to mark one extracted record consumed and mirror the next prompt.

tools.name: mirror-domain-packets
tools.purpose: Write packet output into domain/subdomain folders.

tools.name: audit-shards
tools.purpose: Review generated shards and emit feedback.

tools.name: validate-packets
tools.purpose: Validate packet structure and first-proof coverage.

tools.name: repair-feedback
tools.purpose: Apply fixable feedback and close the loop.
